# MindForm

> MindForm is a free, private productivity dashboard for habit tracking, minute-level task planning, long-term goals and discipline streaks — in one Apple-inspired interface.

MindForm is a full-stack productivity ecosystem that helps people build discipline through data-driven habit tracking, task management, goal progression and psychological wellness monitoring. The web app is free to use; MindForm is proprietary (closed-source) software.

## Core modules

- **Task Tracker**: weekly minute-level planner with day-by-day checkboxes, week score, next-task timer, insights, weekly reflection prompts and CSV export.
- **Habit Tracker**: 30-day habit matrix with streaks, completion rates, daily/weekly charts, mood and motivation tracking (1-10 scale), and CSV export.
- **Goals**: create career, health, personal or general goals with deadlines, categories, statuses and progress computed from linked tasks and habits.
- **Fapless**: a discipline streak engine with 10 identity levels (Novice → Legend), milestone bonuses, challenges (30-day, 90-day protocol), relapse history with reasons and aura points.
- **Speak**: guided voice and communication training in 15, 30 or 60-minute sessions. Drills include 4–2–6 diaphragm breathing, SOVT hums and lip trills, neck release with sustained vowels, English tongue twister ladders (bronze/silver/gold), style-shifting read-alouds and on-camera impromptu speaking with the PREP framework. Camera recordings use the browser MediaRecorder and never leave the device.
- **Social Hub**: opt-in public profiles, a global leaderboard ranked by streak, a follow system and a private community forum where messages auto-delete after 48 hours.
- **Coach** (AI assistant): a chat interface grounded in the user's real tasks, habits, goals and streak. Coach can propose concrete changes — new tasks, habit replans, goals with deadlines — as review cards; nothing is written until the user taps Apply. Quick starts include "Plan my week", "Add habits", "Replan habits", "Set a goal" and "Edit goals". Works with OpenAI, Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude and Mistral, plus OpenRouter, NVIDIA NIM (build.nvidia.com) and any custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint (editable base URL, searchable live model catalogue); the user brings their own API key, which is stored only in their browser.
- **MCP server**: a Model Context Protocol server (HTTP at /mcp, plus a stdio bridge) exposes 13 tools (list/create/update/delete for tasks, habits and goals, plus get_overview) so external MCP clients — Claude Desktop, Cursor, Codex CLI, Antigravity and any MCP-capable agent — can make the same quick edits against your account, authenticated with a personal, revocable account key (no JWT needed). Setup guides at /docs/mcp.

## Privacy model

- Tasks, habits and goals are stored privately in your account and scoped to your user ID.
- AI chat history is automatically deleted every 24 hours.
- Community forum messages automatically delete after 48 hours (TTL index).
- Profiles are private by default; you opt in to appear on the leaderboard.
- Disposable email providers are blocked; bot protection uses honeypots and rate limiting.

## Speak session flow (15-minute daily routine)

1. Breathe — Diaphragm Breathing (4–2–6), 2 minutes.
2. Warm up — SOVT Hum & Lip Trills, 3 minutes.
3. Release — Neck Release + Long Vowels, 2 minutes.
4. Articulate — Tongue Twister Ladder, 4 minutes.
5. Read — Style-Shifting Read-aloud in six styles, 3 minutes.
6. Perform — Camera Studio impromptu with the PREP framework, 1 minute.

A 30-minute "Full workout" adds an Obstacle Course drill (pen-in-mouth / over-tongue) and longer blocks; the 1-hour "Deep practice" adds a Pace & Pause Trainer. Every drill cites the voice-research principle behind it inside the app.

## Technology

- Frontend: React 18, Vite, Recharts, GSAP, Lenis smooth scrolling, Lucide icons.
- Backend: Node.js, Express, JWT auth, Helmet, rate limiting, MongoDB (Mongoose).

MindForm is free forever. There are no paid tiers. The codebase is proprietary and not open for redistribution.
